topics.closure: A frozen carrier and declared selector map predict selector-specific held-out spectral records across regulator refinement, with positivity, trivial-selector and symmetry-breaking controls passed and no boundary-specific bulk refit.
topics.killTest: The spectral distinction disappears under refinement, requires boundary-specific retuning of the bulk law, violates positivity, or is fully explained by an uncontrolled regulator or detector fold.

topics.label: Observer-dependent detector and horizon closure
topics.question: Can one state-to-worldline-to-horizon-to-detector calculation preserve the distinction between local thermal response, global state, geometric boundary and outgoing channel?
topics.nextAction: Execute AZ-144 on the public GW250114 strain and four waveform-family posterior products; use a finite-switching Unruh factorial as the detector regression; build the Hawking state-through-greybody likelihood only after those controls pass.
topics.closure: One frozen model predicts detailed balance, boundary-specific scattering and a detector record across held-out trajectory, spin and frequency controls without identifying local and global closure.
topics.killTest: A fitted temperature substitutes for the state and trajectory; horizon, ergosurface and superradiant threshold are conflated; or an analogue result is promoted to gravitational Hawking radiation.

topics.label: Nuclear open-system seam and channel calibration
topics.question: Can parent structure, channel coupling and detector record be varied independently in one nuclear system and predicted with one held-out open-system model?
topics.nextAction: Audit the two public 2026 clock releases, then execute AZ-143's shared-nucleus/host-specific-channel likelihood wherever point-level metadata and covariance permit. Next choose a compound-resonance isotope for entrance, prompt-coincidence and delayed-tag stress testing.
topics.closure: A shared parent-plus-channel model predicts held-out frequency, lifetime, branching, angular or delay records across at least two host, entrance or isotope controls.
topics.killTest: Every structural change is absorbed into refitted host shifts, total width, missed feeding or detector efficiency; or the proposed grammar adds no prediction beyond modern nuclear and material theory.

trophies.title: The central sign is not the missing orientation datum
trophies.finding: The canonical projective lift returns the carrier frame by -I while preserving determinant orientation. Wilson-loop sign is therefore not automatically a Pfaffian-sheet flip.
trophies.reopen: Supply an independently odd datum such as a reflection, oriented area or calibrated boundary orientation.

trophies.title: One S1 mediator cannot realize the desired pure Furey pulse
trophies.finding: The common mediator that produces the two crossed operators also produces a third Wilson edge; one copy is rank-obstructed and common-orientation positive copies do not remove it.
trophies.reopen: Derive a split-copy involution, source-incidence rule, boundary realization or physical role for the closed triangle.

trophies.title: Complete unified triplets are not automatically proton-safe
trophies.finding: The desired leptoquark arms arrive with four-quark and proton-decay channels. B-L and matter parity do not isolate the safe subset.
trophies.reopen: Provide a source-selecting Pati-Salam, finite-geometry or multi-mediator completion that survives anomaly and mixing tests.

trophies.title: The simplest continuous and binary protections fail
trophies.finding: Family-universal anomaly-free U(1) charges cannot distinguish the safe mask; the universal internal Z2 is weak-anomalous for odd family count.
trophies.reopen: Use a larger cyclic, flavor-dependent, non-Abelian, inflow or finite-geometry mechanism with a complete anomaly ledger.

trophies.title: Healthy bosonic poles do not settle the chiral fold
trophies.finding: A stable bosonic completion can pass pole and positivity tests while leaving the fermionic chirality and anomaly problem untouched.
trophies.reopen: Construct the chiral parent, its anomaly completion and a shared microscopic action rather than importing a bosonic response alone.

trophies.title: The minimal six-dimensional parent is anomalous
trophies.finding: The canonical completion carries the desired index-three structure, but its minimal local 6D parent fails anomaly cancellation.
trophies.reopen: Add a justified spectator or inflow sector without restoring unwanted massless mirrors or changing the claimed index mechanism.

trophies.title: The softened QWZ curve is not the stated Lindbladian response
trophies.finding: The published quadrature can be reproduced phenomenologically, but the exact stationary response of the declared sigma-z Lindbladian vanishes.
trophies.reopen: Derive a corrected open-system generator and compute its exact response, including the noncommuting limits and bath record.

trophies.title: The local gravity route lacks a closed quantum parent
trophies.finding: One critical torsion sector can be healthy, but the known local construction does not supply a complete quantum parent, vacuum and spectrum.
trophies.reopen: Provide a new parent theory with a controlled vacuum, spectrum, anomaly structure and low-energy matching.
